_comment: A lamp. MEAN_LUMINANCE over the wall it lights, with a reference patch of the same wall it does not light — the reference is what makes one threshold work at noon and at midnight. Calibrate by flipping the switch and reading GET /fixtures.
name: living-room-lamp

_comment: A gas burner. SATURATED_BRIGHT_FRACTION because a flame is coloured light, which is what distinguishes it from somebody switching the kitchen light on over the same hob. brightCutoff is lowered from the default 200 because a flame is not as bright as a bulb. Values are small: 0.02 means 2% of the region is lit flame.
name: stove-burner

_comment: A furnace status LED. BRIGHT_FRACTION, because a single small indicator barely moves the mean of any region you can draw around it by hand. confirmFrames 2 is enough — an LED does not flicker like a flame.
name: furnace-running
